What is DPI for Photo Resizing?

DPI (Dots Per Inch) determines how many pixels are printed per inch. For digital photos like US Visa, 300 DPI is standard (2 inches = 600x600 pixels). Higher DPI gives sharper prints but larger file sizes.

US Visa Photo Requirements

  • Dimensions: Exactly 2x2 inches (51x51 mm)
  • Resolution: 300 DPI minimum
  • Format: JPG or PNG
  • Background: Plain white or off-white
  • Recent photo within last 6 months

Passport Photo Guidelines

Most countries require passport photos to be 2x2 inches (51x51mm) with specific guidelines:

  • Neutral facial expression
  • Plain light-colored background
  • No glasses or headwear (religious exceptions)
  • Full front view, centered face
  • Recent photo taken within 6 months
